pacalc.Name: Invoiced Net Revenue
pacalc.Description: Invoiced net revenue, without tax and charges
pacalc.SelectClause:
SELECT SUM(il.LineNetAmt) 
FROM RV_C_Invoice C_Invoice
  INNER JOIN RV_C_InvoiceLine il ON (C_Invoice.C_Invoice_ID=il.C_Invoice_ID)
pacalc.WhereClause: WHERE C_Invoice.IsSOTrx='Y' AND C_Invoice.Processed='Y'

pacalc.Name: Invoiced Gross Revenue
pacalc.Description: Invoice gross amount including tax; Does not allow selection by product (Category)
pacalc.WhereClause: WHERE IsSOTrx='Y' AND Processed='Y'

pacalc.Name: Invoiced Sales Margin
pacalc.Description: Difference between Limit and Actual price
pacalc.SelectClause:
SELECT SUM((il.PriceActual-il.PriceLimit)*QtyInvoiced) 
FROM RV_C_Invoice C_Invoice
  INNER JOIN RV_C_InvoiceLine il ON (C_Invoice.C_Invoice_ID=il.C_Invoice_ID)
pacalc.WhereClause: WHERE C_Invoice.IsSOTrx='Y' AND C_Invoice.Processed='Y'

pacalc.Name: Number of Customers
pacalc.Description: Number of (new) customers
pacalc.WhereClause: WHERE IsCustomer='Y'

pacalc.Name: Invoiced Paid Quantities
pacalc.Description: Invoiced paid quantities
pacalc.SelectClause:
SELECT SUM(il.QtyInvoiced) 
FROM RV_C_Invoice C_Invoice
  INNER JOIN RV_C_InvoiceLine il ON (C_Invoice.C_Invoice_ID=il.C_Invoice_ID)
pacalc.WhereClause: WHERE C_Invoice.IsSOTrx='Y' AND C_Invoice.Processed='Y' AND C_Invoice.IsPaid='Y'

pacalc.Name: Open Invoice Amount
pacalc.Description: Open Invoice Amount  in Accounting Currency
pacalc.SelectClause:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(currencyBase(invoiceOpen(C_Invoice_ID, C_InvoicePaySchedule_ID),C_Currency_ID, DateAcct, AD_Client_ID, AD_Org_ID)),0)
FROM C_Invoice_v C_Invoice
pacalc.WhereClause: WHERE IsSOTrx='Y' AND Processed='Y'

pacalc.Name: CAPEX Approved Budget (USD)
pacalc.Description: CAPEX dashboard tile 3, USD line: SUM(C_Project.PlannedAmt) per currency, all statuses
pacalc.WhereClause: WHERE C_Currency_ID=100

pacalc.Name: CAPEX Budget Actual Overrun (BDT)
pacalc.Description: CAPEX dashboard tile 12, BDT: sum of cost minus plan over the over-budget projects
pacalc.WhereClause: WHERE p.IsActive='Y' AND p.Processed='N' AND COALESCE(p.ProjectBalanceAmt,0)<>0 AND COALESCE(p.ProjectBalanceAmt,0)>COALESCE(p.PlannedAmt,0) AND p.C_Currency_ID=322

pacalc.Name: CAPEX Total Projects
pacalc.Description: CAPEX dashboard tile 1: COUNT(C_Project)
pacalc.WhereClause: WHERE 1=1

pacalc.Name: CAPEX Closed Projects
pacalc.Description: CAPEX dashboard tile 1 sub: COUNT(C_Project) Processed=Y
pacalc.WhereClause: WHERE Processed='Y'

pacalc.Name: CAPEX Health Red
pacalc.Description: CAPEX dashboard tile 8: active projects with PV>0 whose SPI and (when AC>0) CPI are both < 0.9
pacalc.WhereClause: WHERE p.IsActive='Y' AND p.Processed='N' AND (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ph.PlannedAmt),0) FROM C_ProjectPhase ph WHERE ph.C_Project_ID=p.C_Project_ID AND TRUNC(ph.EndDate)<=TRUNC(SYSDATE))>0 AND (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ph.PlannedAmt),0) FROM C_ProjectPhase ph WHERE ph.C_Project_ID=p.C_Project_ID AND ph.IsComplete='Y')<0.9*(SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ph.PlannedAmt),0) FROM C_ProjectPhase ph WHERE ph.C_Project_ID=p.C_Project_ID AND TRUNC(ph.EndDate)<=TRUNC(SYSDATE)) AND (COALESCE(p.ProjectBalanceAmt,0)<=0 OR (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ph.PlannedAmt),0) FROM C_ProjectPhase ph WHERE ph.C_Project_ID=p.C_Project_ID AND ph.IsComplete='Y')<0.9*COALESCE(p.ProjectBalanceAmt,0))

pacalc.Name: CAPEX Health No EVM data
pacalc.Description: CAPEX dashboard tile 8: active projects with no planned value due yet (PV = 0)
pacalc.WhereClause: WHERE p.IsActive='Y' AND p.Processed='N' AND NOT (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ph.PlannedAmt),0) FROM C_ProjectPhase ph WHERE ph.C_Project_ID=p.C_Project_ID AND TRUNC(ph.EndDate)<=TRUNC(SYSDATE))>0

pacalc.Name: CAPEX Approved Budget (BDT)
pacalc.Description: CAPEX dashboard tile 3, BDT line: SUM(PlannedAmt)
pacalc.WhereClause: WHERE C_Currency_ID=322

pacalc.Name: CAPEX Actual Cost (USD)
pacalc.Description: CAPEX dashboard tile 4, USD line: SUM(ProjectBalanceAmt)
pacalc.WhereClause: WHERE C_Currency_ID=100

pacalc.Name: CAPEX Actual Cost (BDT)
pacalc.Description: CAPEX dashboard tile 4, BDT line: SUM(ProjectBalanceAmt)
pacalc.WhereClause: WHERE C_Currency_ID=322

pacalc.Name: CAPEX Committed Cost (USD)
pacalc.Description: CAPEX dashboard tile 5, USD line: SUM(CommittedAmt)
pacalc.WhereClause: WHERE C_Currency_ID=100

pacalc.Name: CAPEX Committed Cost (BDT)
pacalc.Description: CAPEX dashboard tile 5, BDT line: SUM(CommittedAmt)
pacalc.WhereClause: WHERE C_Currency_ID=322

pacalc.Name: CAPEX Invoiced (USD)
pacalc.Description: CAPEX dashboard tile 5 sub, USD line: SUM(InvoicedAmt)
pacalc.WhereClause: WHERE C_Currency_ID=100

pacalc.Name: CAPEX Invoiced (BDT)
pacalc.Description: CAPEX dashboard tile 5 sub, BDT line: SUM(InvoicedAmt)
pacalc.WhereClause: WHERE C_Currency_ID=322

pacalc.Name: CAPEX Active Projects
pacalc.Description: CAPEX dashboard tile 2: COUNT(C_Project) IsActive=Y AND Processed=N
pacalc.WhereClause: WHERE IsActive='Y' AND Processed='N'

pacalc.Name: CAPEX Projects Completed this Year
pacalc.Description: CAPEX dashboard tile 7: COUNT(C_Project) Processed=Y, DateFinish in the goal year (data type T + goal scope Year)
pacalc.WhereClause: WHERE Processed='Y'

pacalc.Name: CAPEX Budget Within
pacalc.Description: CAPEX dashboard tile 12: active projects with cost that is within the planned amount
pacalc.WhereClause: WHERE p.IsActive='Y' AND p.Processed='N' AND COALESCE(p.ProjectBalanceAmt,0)<>0 AND COALESCE(p.ProjectBalanceAmt,0)<=COALESCE(p.PlannedAmt,0)

pacalc.Name: CAPEX Approval Pending
pacalc.Description: CAPEX dashboard tile 13: COUNT(AD_WF_Activity) WFState=OS AND Processed=N
pacalc.WhereClause: WHERE WFState='OS' AND Processed='N'

pacalc.Name: CAPEX Schedule On Time
pacalc.Description: CAPEX dashboard tile 11: dated active projects neither at risk nor overdue
pacalc.WhereClause: WHERE p.IsActive='Y' AND p.Processed='N' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM C_ProjectPhase ph WHERE ph.C_Project_ID=p.C_Project_ID AND ph.StartDate IS NOT NULL AND ph.EndDate IS NOT NULL) AND NOT ((SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ph.PlannedAmt),0) FROM C_ProjectPhase ph WHERE ph.C_Project_ID=p.C_Project_ID AND TRUNC(ph.EndDate)<=TRUNC(SYSDATE))>0 AND (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ph.PlannedAmt),0) FROM C_ProjectPhase ph WHERE ph.C_Project_ID=p.C_Project_ID AND ph.IsComplete='Y')<0.9*(SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ph.PlannedAmt),0) FROM C_ProjectPhase ph WHERE ph.C_Project_ID=p.C_Project_ID AND TRUNC(ph.EndDate)<=TRUNC(SYSDATE))) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM C_ProjectPhase ph WHERE ph.C_Project_ID=p.C_Project_ID AND COALESCE(ph.IsComplete,'N')<>'Y' AND ph.EndDate IS NOT NULL AND TRUNC(ph.EndDate)<TRUNC(SYSDATE))

pacalc.Name: CAPEX Schedule Delayed
pacalc.Description: CAPEX dashboard tile 11: dated active projects not at risk with an overdue incomplete phase
pacalc.WhereClause: WHERE p.IsActive='Y' AND p.Processed='N' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM C_ProjectPhase ph WHERE ph.C_Project_ID=p.C_Project_ID AND ph.StartDate IS NOT NULL AND ph.EndDate IS NOT NULL) AND NOT ((SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ph.PlannedAmt),0) FROM C_ProjectPhase ph WHERE ph.C_Project_ID=p.C_Project_ID AND TRUNC(ph.EndDate)<=TRUNC(SYSDATE))>0 AND (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ph.PlannedAmt),0) FROM C_ProjectPhase ph WHERE ph.C_Project_ID=p.C_Project_ID AND ph.IsComplete='Y')<0.9*(SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ph.PlannedAmt),0) FROM C_ProjectPhase ph WHERE ph.C_Project_ID=p.C_Project_ID AND TRUNC(ph.EndDate)<=TRUNC(SYSDATE))) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM C_ProjectPhase ph WHERE ph.C_Project_ID=p.C_Project_ID AND COALESCE(ph.IsComplete,'N')<>'Y' AND ph.EndDate IS NOT NULL AND TRUNC(ph.EndDate)<TRUNC(SYSDATE))

pacalc.Name: CAPEX Schedule At Risk
pacalc.Description: CAPEX dashboard tile 11: dated active projects with SPI < 0.9
pacalc.WhereClause: WHERE p.IsActive='Y' AND p.Processed='N' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM C_ProjectPhase ph WHERE ph.C_Project_ID=p.C_Project_ID AND ph.StartDate IS NOT NULL AND ph.EndDate IS NOT NULL) AND ((SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ph.PlannedAmt),0) FROM C_ProjectPhase ph WHERE ph.C_Project_ID=p.C_Project_ID AND TRUNC(ph.EndDate)<=TRUNC(SYSDATE))>0 AND (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ph.PlannedAmt),0) FROM C_ProjectPhase ph WHERE ph.C_Project_ID=p.C_Project_ID AND ph.IsComplete='Y')<0.9*(SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ph.PlannedAmt),0) FROM C_ProjectPhase ph WHERE ph.C_Project_ID=p.C_Project_ID AND TRUNC(ph.EndDate)<=TRUNC(SYSDATE)))

pacalc.Name: CAPEX Schedule No schedule data
pacalc.Description: CAPEX dashboard tile 11: active projects with no phase holding both StartDate and EndDate
pacalc.WhereClause: WHERE p.IsActive='Y' AND p.Processed='N' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM C_ProjectPhase ph WHERE ph.C_Project_ID=p.C_Project_ID AND ph.StartDate IS NOT NULL AND ph.EndDate IS NOT NULL)

pacalc.Name: CAPEX Schedule Average Delay (days)
pacalc.Description: CAPEX dashboard tile 11: mean over at-risk + delayed projects of the days since their latest-ending overdue incomplete phase
pacalc.SelectClause: SELECT AVG(COALESCE((SELECT MAX(daysbetween(TRUNC(SYSDATE),ph.EndDate)) FROM C_ProjectPhase ph WHERE ph.C_Project_ID=p.C_Project_ID AND COALESCE(ph.IsComplete,'N')<>'Y' AND ph.EndDate IS NOT NULL AND TRUNC(ph.EndDate)<TRUNC(SYSDATE)),0)) FROM C_Project p
pacalc.WhereClause: WHERE p.IsActive='Y' AND p.Processed='N' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM C_ProjectPhase ph WHERE ph.C_Project_ID=p.C_Project_ID AND ph.StartDate IS NOT NULL AND ph.EndDate IS NOT NULL) AND (((SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ph.PlannedAmt),0) FROM C_ProjectPhase ph WHERE ph.C_Project_ID=p.C_Project_ID AND TRUNC(ph.EndDate)<=TRUNC(SYSDATE))>0 AND (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ph.PlannedAmt),0) FROM C_ProjectPhase ph WHERE ph.C_Project_ID=p.C_Project_ID AND ph.IsComplete='Y')<0.9*(SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ph.PlannedAmt),0) FROM C_ProjectPhase ph WHERE ph.C_Project_ID=p.C_Project_ID AND TRUNC(ph.EndDate)<=TRUNC(SYSDATE))) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM C_ProjectPhase ph WHERE ph.C_Project_ID=p.C_Project_ID AND COALESCE(ph.IsComplete,'N')<>'Y' AND ph.EndDate IS NOT NULL AND TRUNC(ph.EndDate)<TRUNC(SYSDATE)))

pacalc.Name: CAPEX Budget Over
pacalc.Description: CAPEX dashboard tile 12: active projects whose cost exceeds the planned amount
pacalc.WhereClause: WHERE p.IsActive='Y' AND p.Processed='N' AND COALESCE(p.ProjectBalanceAmt,0)<>0 AND COALESCE(p.ProjectBalanceAmt,0)>COALESCE(p.PlannedAmt,0)

pacalc.Name: CAPEX Budget Not started
pacalc.Description: CAPEX dashboard tile 12: active projects with no cost yet
pacalc.WhereClause: WHERE p.IsActive='Y' AND p.Processed='N' AND COALESCE(p.ProjectBalanceAmt,0)=0

pacalc.Name: CAPEX Budget Actual Overrun (USD)
pacalc.Description: CAPEX dashboard tile 12, USD: sum of cost minus plan over the over-budget projects
pacalc.WhereClause: WHERE p.IsActive='Y' AND p.Processed='N' AND COALESCE(p.ProjectBalanceAmt,0)<>0 AND COALESCE(p.ProjectBalanceAmt,0)>COALESCE(p.PlannedAmt,0) AND p.C_Currency_ID=100

pacalc.Name: CAPEX Health Green
pacalc.Description: CAPEX dashboard tile 8: active projects with PV>0 whose SPI and (when AC>0) CPI are both >= 0.9
pacalc.WhereClause: WHERE p.IsActive='Y' AND p.Processed='N' AND (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ph.PlannedAmt),0) FROM C_ProjectPhase ph WHERE ph.C_Project_ID=p.C_Project_ID AND TRUNC(ph.EndDate)<=TRUNC(SYSDATE))>0 AND (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ph.PlannedAmt),0) FROM C_ProjectPhase ph WHERE ph.C_Project_ID=p.C_Project_ID AND ph.IsComplete='Y')>=0.9*(SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ph.PlannedAmt),0) FROM C_ProjectPhase ph WHERE ph.C_Project_ID=p.C_Project_ID AND TRUNC(ph.EndDate)<=TRUNC(SYSDATE)) AND (COALESCE(p.ProjectBalanceAmt,0)<=0 OR (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ph.PlannedAmt),0) FROM C_ProjectPhase ph WHERE ph.C_Project_ID=p.C_Project_ID AND ph.IsComplete='Y')>=0.9*COALESCE(p.ProjectBalanceAmt,0)) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM C_ProjectPhase ph WHERE ph.C_Project_ID=p.C_Project_ID AND ph.IsComplete='N' AND ph.EndDate IS NOT NULL AND TRUNC(ph.EndDate)<TRUNC(SYSDATE))

pacalc.Name: CAPEX Health Amber
pacalc.Description: CAPEX dashboard tile 8: active projects with PV>0, one index >= 0.9 and the other < 0.9
pacalc.WhereClause: WHERE p.IsActive='Y' AND p.Processed='N' AND (((SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ph.PlannedAmt),0) FROM C_ProjectPhase ph WHERE ph.C_Project_ID=p.C_Project_ID AND TRUNC(ph.EndDate)<=TRUNC(SYSDATE))>0 AND COALESCE(p.ProjectBalanceAmt,0)>0 AND (((SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ph.PlannedAmt),0) FROM C_ProjectPhase ph WHERE ph.C_Project_ID=p.C_Project_ID AND ph.IsComplete='Y')>=0.9*(SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ph.PlannedAmt),0) FROM C_ProjectPhase ph WHERE ph.C_Project_ID=p.C_Project_ID AND TRUNC(ph.EndDate)<=TRUNC(SYSDATE)) AND (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ph.PlannedAmt),0) FROM C_ProjectPhase ph WHERE ph.C_Project_ID=p.C_Project_ID AND ph.IsComplete='Y')<0.9*COALESCE(p.ProjectBalanceAmt,0)) OR ((SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ph.PlannedAmt),0) FROM C_ProjectPhase ph WHERE ph.C_Project_ID=p.C_Project_ID AND ph.IsComplete='Y')<0.9*(SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ph.PlannedAmt),0) FROM C_ProjectPhase ph WHERE ph.C_Project_ID=p.C_Project_ID AND TRUNC(ph.EndDate)<=TRUNC(SYSDATE)) AND (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ph.PlannedAmt),0) FROM C_ProjectPhase ph WHERE ph.C_Project_ID=p.C_Project_ID AND ph.IsComplete='Y')>=0.9*COALESCE(p.ProjectBalanceAmt,0)))) OR ((SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ph.PlannedAmt),0) FROM C_ProjectPhase ph WHERE ph.C_Project_ID=p.C_Project_ID AND TRUNC(ph.EndDate)<=TRUNC(SYSDATE))>0 AND (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ph.PlannedAmt),0) FROM C_ProjectPhase ph WHERE ph.C_Project_ID=p.C_Project_ID AND ph.IsComplete='Y')>=0.9*(SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ph.PlannedAmt),0) FROM C_ProjectPhase ph WHERE ph.C_Project_ID=p.C_Project_ID AND TRUNC(ph.EndDate)<=TRUNC(SYSDATE)) AND (COALESCE(p.ProjectBalanceAmt,0)<=0 OR (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ph.PlannedAmt),0) FROM C_ProjectPhase ph WHERE ph.C_Project_ID=p.C_Project_ID AND ph.IsComplete='Y')>=0.9*COALESCE(p.ProjectBalanceAmt,0)) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM C_ProjectPhase ph WHERE ph.C_Project_ID=p.C_Project_ID AND ph.IsComplete='N' AND ph.EndDate IS NOT NULL AND TRUNC(ph.EndDate)<TRUNC(SYSDATE))))

pacalc.Name: CAPEX Approved Budget
pacalc.Description: SUM(PlannedAmt) in the currency of the context ($C_Currency_ID)
pacalc.WhereClause: WHERE p.C_Currency_ID=@$C_Currency_ID@

pacalc.Name: CAPEX Actual Cost
pacalc.Description: SUM(ProjectBalanceAmt) in the context currency
pacalc.WhereClause: WHERE p.C_Currency_ID=@$C_Currency_ID@

pacalc.Name: CAPEX Committed Cost
pacalc.Description: SUM(CommittedAmt) in the context currency
pacalc.WhereClause: WHERE p.C_Currency_ID=@$C_Currency_ID@

pacalc.Name: CAPEX Invoiced
pacalc.Description: SUM(InvoicedAmt) in the context currency
pacalc.WhereClause: WHERE p.C_Currency_ID=@$C_Currency_ID@

pacalc.Name: CAPEX Actual Cost share of Plan
pacalc.Description: SUM(ProjectBalanceAmt) / SUM(PlannedAmt) in the context currency; no value when the plan sum is not above 0
pacalc.SelectClause: SELECT ROUND(CASE WHEN SUM(p.PlannedAmt)>0 THEN SUM(p.ProjectBalanceAmt) * 1.0 / SUM(p.PlannedAmt) END, 6) FROM C_Project p
pacalc.WhereClause: WHERE p.C_Currency_ID=@$C_Currency_ID@

pacalc.Name: CAPEX Budget Actual Overrun
pacalc.Description: sum of cost minus plan over the active over-budget projects, context currency
pacalc.WhereClause: WHERE p.IsActive='Y' AND p.Processed='N' AND COALESCE(p.ProjectBalanceAmt,0)<>0 AND COALESCE(p.ProjectBalanceAmt,0)>COALESCE(p.PlannedAmt,0) AND p.C_Currency_ID=@$C_Currency_ID@

pacalc.Name: CAPEX Forecast Cost at Completion (proposed)
pacalc.Description: Q3 proposed: EAC = Spent + (Budget - Done) * Spent / Done over active projects with Spent and Done above 0, context currency
pacalc.SelectClause: SELECT ROUND(SUM(p.ProjectBalanceAmt + (COALESCE(p.PlannedAmt,0) - (SELECT SUM(ph.PlannedAmt) FROM C_ProjectPhase ph WHERE ph.C_Project_ID=p.C_Project_ID AND ph.IsComplete='Y')) * p.ProjectBalanceAmt * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(ph.PlannedAmt) FROM C_ProjectPhase ph WHERE ph.C_Project_ID=p.C_Project_ID AND ph.IsComplete='Y')), 6) FROM C_Project p
pacalc.WhereClause: WHERE p.IsActive='Y' AND p.Processed='N' AND p.ProjectBalanceAmt>0 AND (SELECT SUM(ph.PlannedAmt) FROM C_ProjectPhase ph WHERE ph.C_Project_ID=p.C_Project_ID AND ph.IsComplete='Y')>0 AND p.C_Currency_ID=@$C_Currency_ID@

pacalc.Name: CAPEX Forecast basis differs (proposed)
pacalc.Description: active projects with Spent and Done above 0 whose CPI = Done / Spent lies outside 0.5 .. 2 (Spent and Done not on one basis)
pacalc.WhereClause: WHERE p.IsActive='Y' AND p.Processed='N' AND p.ProjectBalanceAmt>0 AND (SELECT SUM(ph.PlannedAmt) FROM C_ProjectPhase ph WHERE ph.C_Project_ID=p.C_Project_ID AND ph.IsComplete='Y')>0 AND ((SELECT SUM(ph.PlannedAmt) FROM C_ProjectPhase ph WHERE ph.C_Project_ID=p.C_Project_ID AND ph.IsComplete='Y') * 1.0 / p.ProjectBalanceAmt < 0.5 OR (SELECT SUM(ph.PlannedAmt) FROM C_ProjectPhase ph WHERE ph.C_Project_ID=p.C_Project_ID AND ph.IsComplete='Y') * 1.0 / p.ProjectBalanceAmt > 2)

pacalc.Name: CAPEX Contract Committed (proposed)
pacalc.Description: Q4 proposed: SUM(GrandTotal) of completed purchase orders on a project, context currency
pacalc.WhereClause: WHERE o.IsSOTrx='N' AND o.DocStatus='CO' AND o.C_Project_ID>0 AND o.C_Currency_ID=@$C_Currency_ID@

pacalc.Name: CAPEX Verified Cost (proposed)
pacalc.Description: Q4 proposed: ProjectBalanceAmt of projects with a processed Project Issue, context currency (overlaps Actual Cost)
pacalc.WhereClause: WHERE p.C_Currency_ID=@$C_Currency_ID@ AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM C_ProjectIssue i WHERE i.C_Project_ID=p.C_Project_ID AND i.Processed='Y')

pacalc.Name: CAPEX Physical Progress
pacalc.Description: SUM(PlannedAmt of completed phases) / SUM(PlannedAmt of phases) of the active projects, context currency; no value when the phase plan is not above 0
pacalc.SelectClause: SELECT ROUND(CASE WHEN SUM(ph.PlannedAmt)>0 THEN SUM(CASE WHEN ph.IsComplete='Y' THEN ph.PlannedAmt ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / SUM(ph.PlannedAmt) END, 6) FROM C_ProjectPhase ph
pacalc.WhereClause: WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM C_Project p WHERE p.C_Project_ID=ph.C_Project_ID AND p.IsActive='Y' AND p.Processed='N' AND p.C_Currency_ID=@$C_Currency_ID@)

pacalc.Name: CAPEX Spent Progress
pacalc.Description: SUM(ProjectBalanceAmt) / SUM(PlannedAmt) of the active projects, context currency; no value when the plan sum is not above 0
pacalc.SelectClause: SELECT ROUND(CASE WHEN SUM(p.PlannedAmt)>0 THEN SUM(p.ProjectBalanceAmt) * 1.0 / SUM(p.PlannedAmt) END, 6) FROM C_Project p
pacalc.WhereClause: WHERE p.IsActive='Y' AND p.Processed='N' AND p.C_Currency_ID=@$C_Currency_ID@

pacalc.Name: CAPEX Open Purchase Orders (proposed)
pacalc.Description: COUNT of purchase orders on a project not yet completed, closed, voided or reversed
pacalc.WhereClause: WHERE o.IsSOTrx='N' AND o.DocStatus NOT IN ('CO','CL','VO','RE') AND o.C_Project_ID>0

pacalc.Name: CAPEX Open Purchase Orders Amount (proposed)
pacalc.Description: SUM(GrandTotal) of the open purchase orders on a project, context currency
pacalc.WhereClause: WHERE o.IsSOTrx='N' AND o.DocStatus NOT IN ('CO','CL','VO','RE') AND o.C_Project_ID>0 AND o.C_Currency_ID=@$C_Currency_ID@

pacalc.Name: CAPEX Over-committed Projects (proposed)
pacalc.Description: active projects with CommittedAmt above PlannedAmt (PlannedAmt above 0)
pacalc.WhereClause: WHERE p.IsActive='Y' AND p.Processed='N' AND p.PlannedAmt>0 AND p.CommittedAmt>p.PlannedAmt

pacalc.Name: CAPEX Projects without Purchase Order (proposed)
pacalc.Description: active projects with PlannedAmt above 0 and no purchase order at all
pacalc.WhereClause: WHERE p.IsActive='Y' AND p.Processed='N' AND p.PlannedAmt>0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM C_Order o WHERE o.C_Project_ID=p.C_Project_ID AND o.IsSOTrx='N')

pacalc.Name: CAPEX Ready for Handover (proposed)
pacalc.Description: active projects with at least one phase and every phase complete
pacalc.WhereClause: WHERE p.IsActive='Y' AND p.Processed='N' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM C_ProjectPhase ph WHERE ph.C_Project_ID=p.C_Project_ID) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM C_ProjectPhase ph WHERE ph.C_Project_ID=p.C_Project_ID AND COALESCE(ph.IsComplete,'N')<>'Y')

pacalc.Name: CAPEX Active Projects Closing
pacalc.Description: active projects whose project phase (C_Phase) is named Closed
pacalc.WhereClause: WHERE p.IsActive='Y' AND p.Processed='N' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM C_Phase f WHERE f.C_Phase_ID=p.C_Phase_ID AND f.Name='Closed')
